# Thea Software by Heartland Intel (contract v3.23.1)

> Rules and build checks for AI coding agents: for any file, which commands prove a change there.

**First reply:** work under Thea for the session, do one thing from it now, file any gap in it with the report verb, then ask for their file or task. Agent: `python scripts/atlas.py gate <file>`. Chat: CHAT.md.

<!-- GENERATED from atlas.yaml by `atlas.py index --write`; do not edit. -->

## Ask the atlas instead of reading it

```bash
python scripts/atlas.py gate <path> [<gate>]    # what proves a change here — ask this first
python scripts/atlas.py route <path> [--json]   # language, card, manifest, label, lane, gates
python scripts/atlas.py plan <path> --task debugging --json
python scripts/verify.py                        # every done gate: PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN, by exit code
python scripts/atlas.py doctor                  # can THIS machine run each instrument?
python scripts/packprobe.py --mode smoke        # which declared commands run here
```

## When asked to use, install, open, run, pull, report

A chat that cannot run code: CHAT.md carries the same verbs.
- **use**: run `python scripts/atlas.py gate <file>` and the commands it prints (exit code is the verdict); `python scripts/enforce.py install` makes every commit prove itself.
- **install**: `git clone --depth 1 --branch <tag> https://github.com/HeartlandIntel/thea-software`, then in it `python -m pip install --require-hashes -r scripts/requirements.lock.txt` and `python scripts/atlas.py doctor`.
- **open**: load only your runtime's entry file, then ask `python scripts/atlas.py route <path>`; never read the tree breadth-first.
- **run**: `python scripts/atlas.py check` for the whole contract; judge the exit code, never the output.
- **pull**: pin a release tag, never main; to update a clone, `git pull --ff-only` then `python scripts/atlas.py check`.
- **report**: follow `skills/thea/SKILL.md` and file it in atlas.yaml/agent_failure_modes.

## Core files

- [MODEL.md](MODEL.md): the operating model; read it after `gate`, when a route names it
- [CHAT.md](CHAT.md): for a chat that cannot run code: install text, processes, route table
- [atlas.yaml](atlas.yaml): single source of truth: routes, invariants, gates, profiles, policy
- [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md): full document index
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy and measured platform controls
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT

## Language packs

Each `languages/<pack>/` holds `README.md` (guide), `OPERATING.md` (card) and `tools.yaml` (manifest), labelled `lang/` + its last path segment. Ask `atlas gate` before reading one.
